types.name: chain.guard.v1.BatchSignProtectedActionItem
types.doc:
BatchSignProtectedActionItem is one protected FundingAccount action inside a
 batched SmartAccount submission. The service signs items in this exact order.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: Protected action to approve for this batch item.

fields.name: args
fields.doc: Business arguments for this batch item.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.BatchSignProtectedActionsRequest
types.doc:
BatchSignProtectedActionsRequest requests ordered approvals for one batched
 SmartAccount transaction. The server reads the first nonce from chain and
 assigns subsequent nonces by incrementing locally within this response.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional subaccount public id. When omitted, the authenticated caller's
 root account is used as the target account.

fields.name: actions
fields.doc: Ordered protected actions to sign, max 20 items.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.BatchSignProtectedActionsResponse
types.doc:
BatchSignProtectedActionsResponse returns approvals in the same order as the
 requested actions. Clients must submit them with the matching batched calls.

fields.name: approvals
fields.doc: Approval signatures in the same order as the requested actions.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.CreateGuardSignerWalletRequest
types.doc:
CreateGuardSignerWalletRequest creates a guard signer wallet for the selected
 account target.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional subaccount public id. When omitted, the authenticated caller's
 root account is used as the target account.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.CreateGuardSignerWalletResponse
types.doc: CreateGuardSignerWalletResponse returns the generated signer address.

fields.name: signer_address
fields.doc: EVM address of the created guard signer wallet.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.ExportGuardSignerWalletRequest
types.doc:
ExportGuardSignerWalletRequest exports guard signer key material for an
 explicitly authorized account target. This is a high-risk sovereignty flow.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional subaccount public id. When omitted, the authenticated caller's
 root account is used as the target account.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.ExportGuardSignerWalletResponse
types.doc: ExportGuardSignerWalletResponse returns the authorized high-risk wallet export.

fields.name: private_key
fields.doc: Hex-encoded private key returned only after export authorization succeeds.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.ExternalWhitelistArgs
types.doc:
ExternalWhitelistArgs contains the final external-chain destination bytes for
 whitelist updates. For EVM destinations, callers should pass the same
 string-encoded normalized address bytes used in WithdrawRequest.to, e.g.
 stringToHex(address.toLowerCase()), not raw address bytes.

fields.name: polychain_chain_id
fields.doc: External network identifier for the whitelist update.

fields.name: addresses
fields.doc: Hex-encoded destination payloads to add or remove. Each value must be 0x-prefixed bytes.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.GetGuardSignerStatusRequest
types.doc:
GetGuardSignerStatusRequest queries stored and live signer status for one
 account target.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional subaccount public id. When omitted, the authenticated caller's
 root account is used as the target account.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.GetGuardSignerStatusResponse
types.doc: GetGuardSignerStatusResponse returns stored and on-chain signer state.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Stored and live guard signer status for the selected account target.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.GuardApproval
types.doc:
GuardApproval is the exact approval payload clients submit to protected
 contract calls.

fields.name: nonce_space
fields.doc: Nonce space used for the signed approval. Normal flows use 0.

fields.name: deadline_unix
fields.doc: Deadline as a unix timestamp in seconds, derived from chain time.

fields.name: signature
fields.doc: EIP-712 signature over the guard approval message.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.GuardSignerStatus
types.doc: GuardSignerStatus describes stored and live signer state for one account.

fields.name: signer_address
fields.doc: Stored guard signer EVM address, if a wallet exists for the selected account.

fields.name: onchain_signer_address
fields.doc: Live on-chain signer value when chain reads are available.

fields.name: initialized
fields.doc: True when the stored signer matches the live on-chain signer.

fields.name: nonce
fields.doc: Current guard signer nonce for the default nonce space, encoded as a base-10 decimal string.

fields.name: nonce_space
fields.doc: Default nonce space used for normal approvals.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.InternalWhitelistArgs
types.doc:
InternalWhitelistArgs contains EVM account addresses for internal whitelist
 updates.

fields.name: addresses
fields.doc: EVM account addresses to add or remove from the internal transfer whitelist.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.ProtectedAction
types.doc:
ProtectedAction identifies one server-owned action that can receive a guard
 approval. The server derives target, selector, paramsHash, nonce, and deadline.

values.name: PROTECTED_ACTION_FUNDING_SET_EXTERNAL_WHITELIST_REQUIRED
values.doc:
Set the external whitelist requirement to false. Enabling the requirement
 does not need GuardSigner approval and should not be routed here.

values.name: PROTECTED_ACTION_FUNDING_ADD_EXTERNAL_WHITELIST
values.doc: Add external withdrawal destinations to the funding-account whitelist.

values.name: PROTECTED_ACTION_FUNDING_REMOVE_EXTERNAL_WHITELIST
values.doc: Remove external withdrawal destinations from the funding-account whitelist.

values.name: PROTECTED_ACTION_FUNDING_ADD_INTERNAL_WHITELIST
values.doc: Add internal transfer destinations to the funding-account whitelist.

values.name: PROTECTED_ACTION_FUNDING_REMOVE_INTERNAL_WHITELIST
values.doc: Remove internal transfer destinations from the funding-account whitelist.

values.name: PROTECTED_ACTION_FUNDING_SET_INTERNAL_WHITELIST_REQUIRED
values.doc:
Set the internal whitelist requirement to false. Enabling the requirement
 does not need GuardSigner approval and should not be routed here.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.ProtectedActionArgs
types.doc:
ProtectedActionArgs contains business arguments for the selected protected
 action. It intentionally excludes trusted account, nonce, and deadline fields.

fields.name: external_whitelist
fields.doc: External whitelist destinations for external whitelist add or remove actions.

fields.name: internal_whitelist
fields.doc: Internal account addresses for internal whitelist add or remove actions.

fields.name: whitelist_requirement
fields.doc: Requirement state for external/internal requirement setter actions.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.RotateGuardSignerWalletRequest
types.doc:
RotateGuardSignerWalletRequest asks the backend to generate a replacement
 guard signer wallet and sign the on-chain rotation approval.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional subaccount public id. When omitted, the authenticated caller's
 root account is used as the target account.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.RotateGuardSignerWalletResponse
types.doc:
RotateGuardSignerWalletResponse returns the backend-generated replacement
 signer and the approval needed to submit signer rotation on-chain.

fields.name: new_signer_address
fields.doc: EVM address of the replacement guard signer wallet.

fields.name: approval
fields.doc: Approval signature payload needed to submit the signer rotation.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.SignProtectedActionRequest
types.doc:
SignProtectedActionRequest requests an approval for a supported FundingAccount
 protected action.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional subaccount public id. When omitted, the authenticated caller's
 root account is used as the target account.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: Protected action to approve.

fields.name: args
fields.doc: Business arguments for the selected protected action.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.SignProtectedActionResponse
types.doc: SignProtectedActionResponse returns the contract submission approval.

fields.name: approval
fields.doc: Approval signature payload for the requested protected action.

types.name: chain.guard.v1.WhitelistRequirementArgs
types.doc:
WhitelistRequirementArgs contains the requested whitelist requirement state.
 Guard approvals are only needed to disable a requirement.

fields.name: required
fields.doc:
Required must be false for GuardSigner approvals. Enabling a requirement
 uses an empty approval on-chain and should not be signed here.
